title: Vegan Spanish Paella
description: A vegan twist on the classic Spanish dish, made with sautéed vegetables, rice, and a hint of smoky paprika. Perfect for a hearty and flavorful meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced red bell pepper and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the diced tomato and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the smoked paprika and stir to combine.
Add the sliced vegan chorizo and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the Spanish rice and stir to combine.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently, until the rice is lightly toasted.
Add 2 cups of water to the pan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove the pan from the heat and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
